test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A man can cover a certain distance in 2 hours and 10 minutes if he walks at the rate of 12 km/hr. If he covers the same distance on cycle at the rate of 13 km/hr, then find the time taken by him.
solution:
**Given**

Distance covered by walking = Distance covered by cycling

Speed of walking = 12 km/hr

Speed of cycling = 13 km/hr

Time taken to walk = 2 hours 10 minutes = 2.167 hours

**Formulas Used**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Solution**

Distance = Speed of walking × Time taken to walk = 12 km/hr × 2.167 hours = 26 km

Time taken to cycle = Distance/Speed of cycling = 26 km/13 km/hr = 2 hours = 120 minutes

**Therefore, the time taken to cover the same distance on a cycle is 120 minutes**
